Hi Kimberly / Vivek,

Thanks — I self-registered for the Private deployment demo and I see a calendar invite but there appears to be a timezone mismatch. The invite shows 10:00 AM (PST) but our team in Boston is on EDT and that would be 1:00 PM for us. Can you confirm which timezone the scheduled slot is in?

Also, because this is for a regulated workflow, procurement and our security lead asked for a short pre-demo packet: SOC 2 summary, a one-page network requirements doc, and an outline of what access you’ll need during a demo (IP ranges, any temporary keys, etc.). Can you surface those before we lock the slot? Procurement prefers to review materials before the call.

Attendees likely: me (security), Rajesh Sinha (engineering lead), and our procurement reviewer (procurement@medalign.com).

Thanks,
Julie Bennett
Head of Security, MedAlign Health

Hi Julie — thanks for the heads up and apologies for the confusion. The invite was created in PDT by our scheduler; the correct time should be 1:00 PM EDT (13:00 EDT) on the invite day. I updated the calendar and pushed a corrected invite; you should see it from calendly@redwood.ai with the subject "Redwood Inference — Private deployment demo with MedAlign". Please confirm you received the updated invite and the 13:00 EDT time looks good.

I’ve pasted three things below to make the pre-demo review quicker:
- Quick ask: could you confirm final attendee list and whether procurement wants a separate 15-min pre-call?
- Proposed demo slots (all your local EDT):
  • Wed 16 Jun — 13:00–13:45 EDT
  • Thu 17 Jun — 09:00–09:45 EDT
  • Thu 17 Jun — 16:00–16:45 EDT

I’m attaching a one-page network checklist and a very short SOC2 summary (see attachments). If procurement needs a redline of our standard MSA/NDA path I can loop Legal but we usually surface an NDA/DocuSign after discovery.

Attachments: network-requirements.xlsx (stub), SOC2-Summary.pdf (stub)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 4:02 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I updated the calendar and pushed a corrected invite; you should see it from calendly@redwood.ai

Hi Vivek — I see the corrected invite now, thanks. Wed 16 Jun 13:00 EDT works for Rajesh and me. Procurement asked whether you can provide a short pre-demo checklist and confirm if the demo requires any inbound ports to be opened to our environment. They also wanted to confirm that the demo environment will not receive any of our customer data — it must be a synthetic dataset.

If you can send the pre-demo checklist and the SOC2 summary (PDF) and a simple statement that the demo will only use synthetic data, we can move procurement along and confirm the calendar. Also: we will need a network diagram before legal approves any remote connectivity. Can you share a diagram or provide a stub for what you typically ask for?

Julie
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment demo — timezone & compliance preflight

Julie — great, thanks for confirming Wed 16 Jun at 13:00 EDT. We’ll lock that slot.

Short answers up front:
- Demo dataset: confirmed — we will use a synthetic dataset only; no customer PII will be ingested or retained.
- Network: demo does not require inbound ports to your production network. If the team wants a hands-on sandbox later we can discuss an IP allowlist or temporary reverse-tunnel approach, but that is a separate follow-up and will only proceed with procurement sign-off.
- Pre-demo materials: attaching the SOC2 summary and a short pre-demo checklist that includes the network stub and required artifacts (see attachments). I’ve also attached a sample network-requirements workbook that lists the fields Procurement typically asks for.

Neha (CS) and Karthik (Solutions Eng) are on copy and will join the demo. If procurement would like a 15-minute pre-call we can do that on Tue 15 Jun 16:30 EDT — otherwise we’ll aim for the Wed slot.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Summary.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.docx, network-requirements.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the demo. Please reply with an attendee confirmation and whether Procurement wants the 15-min pre-call.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
